{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

# Check conversion rate by channel
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean())

# Check conversion rate by customer_segment
print("\nConversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean())"}
